Ramat HaSharon]] | years18 = 2017 | team18 = Atletico Echague Parana | years19 = 2018 | team19 = [[Capitanes de Arecibo]] | highlights = *[[FIBA Intercontinental Cup]] champion ([[2014 FIBA Intercontinental Cup|2014]]) *Second-team All-[[Conference USA|C-USA]] (2010) }} '''Derrick Eugene Caracter''' (born May 4, 1988) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who played briefly in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) for the [[Los Angeles Lakers]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]] and [[UTEP Miners basketball|UTEP Miners]]. ==High school and college career== Caracter grew up in [[Fanwood, New Jersey]]. He began attracting interest from college scouts in 2002 at the age of 14.{{cite web |last1=Davis |first1=Seth |title=Looming Large Derrick Caracter, a 14-year-old eighth-grader who is 6'9" and 286 pounds, has college scouts drooling |url=https://www.si.com/vault/2002/08/12/327654/looming-large-derrick-caracter-a-14-year-old-eighth-grader-who-is-69quot-and-286-pounds-has-college-scouts-drooling |website=Sports Illustrated |publisher=© 2019 TI Gotham Inc., a subsidiary of Meredith Corporation. Sports Illustrated Group. |access-date=28 December 2019 |date=12 August 2002}} He played high school basketball at [[St. Patrick High School (New Jersey)|St. Patrick High School]] as a freshman, and attended [[Scotch Plains-Fanwood High School]] as a sophomore before returning to St. Patrick's for his junior year. Caracter transferred to a boarding school, [[Notre Dame Preparatory School (Fitchburg, Massachusetts)|Notre Dame Preparatory School]], during his senior year to focus on academics. In 2006, he began his college career at the [[University of Louisville]].[https://www.nytimes.com/2010/03/18/sports/ncaabasketball/18caracter.html Can't-Miss Prospect May Make It After All] He withdrew from the [[2008 NBA draft]] and later that summer left the University of Louisville. He then enrolled at [[University of Texas at El Paso|UTEP]] and, as required by NCAA regulations, sat out the 2008–09 basketball season. He became eligible to play in the second half of the 2009–10 season where he averaged 14.1 points and 8.1 rebounds in 27 games as a junior with the Miners. In three college seasons, he averaged 10.2 points (.560 FG%) and 5.6 rebounds in 80 games (36 starts). ==Professional career== ===Los Angeles Lakers (2010–2012)=== ====2010–11 season==== Caracter was selected with the 58th overall pick by the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] in the [[2010 NBA draft]]. He joined the Lakers for the 2010 NBA Summer League. On August 15, 2010, he signed a multi-year, rookie deal with the Lakers.[https://www.espn.com/los-angeles/nba/news/story?id=5461968 Lakers sign Derrick Caracter] On March 29, 2011, he was assigned to the [[Bakersfield Jam]] of the [[NBA D-League]].[http://lakersblog.latimes.com/lakersblog/2011/03/derrick-caracter-assigned-to-d-league-team-in-bakersfield.html?cid=6a00d8341c506253ef014e8719bd6d970d Derrick Caracter sent by Lakers to D-League team in Bakersfield] On April 5, 2011, he was recalled by the Lakers. He was reassigned to the Jam the next day. On April 13, he was again recalled by the Lakers.[http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Derrick-Caracter/Summary/2581 Derrick Caracter Player Profile – RealGM] ====2011–12 season==== On December 12, 2011, Caracter tore his left lateral meniscus during practice.[https://www.espn.com/blog/los-angeles/lakers/post/_/id/24470/derrick-caracter-has-torn-lateral-meniscus Derrick Caracter has torn lateral meniscus] Throughout rehabilitation he attended team games, but didn't return to play. On January 25, 2012, he was assigned to the Los Angeles D-Fenders.[http://www.nba.com/lakers/news/120125_caracter_dfenders.html LAKERS ASSIGN DERRICK CARACTER TO LOS ANGELES D-FENDERS] On February 7, 2012, he was recalled by the Lakers and subsequently waived the same day.[http://www.nba.com/lakers/news/120207_waive_caracter.html LAKERS WAIVE DERRICK CARACTER] On February 22, 2012, he was acquired by the Rio Grande Valley Vipers. On March 22, 2012, he was waived by the Vipers. On March 26, 2012, he was acquired by the [[Idaho Stampede]]. On April 21, 2012, he signed with [[Mets de Guaynabo (basketball)|Mets de Guaynabo]] for the rest of the 2012 [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional|BSN]] season.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/world/america/37932/mets-de-guaynabo-land-former-laker-derrick-caracter.html Mets de Guaynabo land former Laker Derrick Caracter] In his debut, he recorded 17 points and 5 rebounds in 19 minutes of play.[http://www.ridiculousupside.com/2012/4/22/2965317/former-laker-caracter-signs-in-puerto-rico-chance-to-battle-back-to Former Laker Caracter Signs In Puerto Rico, Chance To Battle Back To NBA] On May 1, 2012, he left Mets de Guaynabo.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/world/america/38264/mets-de-guaynabo-replace-derrick-caracter-with-will-mcdonald.html Mets de Guaynabo replace Derrick Caracter with Will McDonald] ===2012–13 season=== In July 2012, he joined the Atlanta Hawks for the 2012 NBA Summer League. He later signed with [[Guangdong Southern Tigers]] of China for the 2012–13 season. On November 19, 2012, he left Guangdong after one pre-season game.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/world/asia/46487/guangdong-southern-tigers-sign-ike-diogu-to-replace-derrick-caracter.html Guangdong Southern Tigers sign Ike Diogu to replace Derrick Caracter] On December 4, 2012, he signed with [[Bnei Herzliya]] of Israel for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=Derrick Caracter signs with Bnei Herzliya|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/israel/47331/derrick-caracter-signs-with-bnei-herzliya.html|access-date=January 27, 2014|work=Sportando.net|date=December 4, 2012}} ===2013–14 season=== On August 26, 2013, he signed with [[Śląsk Wrocław (basketball)|Śląsk Wrocław]] of Poland.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/poland/62226/slask-wroclaw-sign-derrick-caracter-and-jakub-parzenski.html Slask Wroclaw sign Derrick Caracter and Jakub Parzenski] On September 4, 2013, he was released before playing in a game for them.{{cite news|title=Dwaj nowi Amerykanie. Caracter poza Śląskiem!|url=http://www.slask.polskikosz.pl/index.php?Action=Full&NewsID=2328|date=September 4, 2013|access-date=September 5, 2013|work=SLASK.polskikosz.pl|language=pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131112182341/http://www.slask.polskikosz.pl/index.php?Action=Full&NewsID=2328|archive-date=November 12, 2013|url-status=dead}}[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/poland/62772/zeke-marshall-replaces-derrick-caracter-in-slask-wroclaw.html Zeke Marshall replaces Derrick Caracter in Slask Wroclaw] On October 11, 2013, he signed with [[BC Pieno žvaigždės]] of Lithuania for the rest of the 2013–14 season.[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europe/lithuania/65064/derrick-caracter-signs-with-pieno-zvaigzdes.html Derrick Caracter signs with Pieno Zvaigzdes] In December 2013, he left Pieno. On January 29, 2014, he was acquired by the Idaho Stampede.[http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/stampede_acquire_derrick_carac_2014_01_29.html Stampede Acquire Derrick Caracter] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140413175354/http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/stampede_acquire_derrick_carac_2014_01_29.html |date=2014-04-13 }} ===2014–15 season=== On September 19, 2014, Caracter signed a one-year deal with [[Flamengo Basketball]] of the [[Novo Basquete Brasil]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/135357/flamengo-signs-derrick-caracter.html Flamengo signs Derrick Caracter] He went on to help Flamengo win the [[2014 FIBA Intercontinental Cup]] nine days later before leaving the club in October 2014. He went on to have a stint in Taiwan and Uruguay in early 2015 before signing with [[GlobalPort Batang Pier]] of the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] on March 11.[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/154951/derrick-caracter-moves-to-global-port.html Derrick Caracter moves to Global Port] ===2015–16 season=== On October 31, 2015, Caracter was acquired by the [[Erie BayHawks (2008–2017)|Erie BayHawks]] of the NBA Development League.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/erie-bayhawks-announce-affiliate-returning-players/n-5065433|title=Erie BayHawks Announce Affiliate, Returning Players|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 31, 2015|access-date=October 31, 2015}} On November 14, he made his debut for the BayHawks in an 83–79 loss to the [[Westchester Knicks]], recording seven points and nine rebounds in 21 minutes.{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/games/20151114/ERIWES/|title=Summers Scores 30 as Knicks Claw Back to Top BayHawks|work=NBA.com|date=November 14, 2015|access-date=November 14, 2015}} On February 2, 2016, he was waived by the BayHawks. In 24 games, he averaged 4.8 points and 3.6 rebounds on 44% shooting in 11.3 minutes of play.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/bayhawks-make-roster-moves/n-5096491|title=BayHawks Make Roster Moves|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=February 2, 2016|access-date=February 2, 2016}} On February 24, he signed with Hapoel Ramat Gan Givatayim of the [[Liga Leumit (basketball)|Liga Leumit]].{{cite web|url=http://www.eurobasket.com/Israel/news/438848/Derrick-Caracter-agreed-terms-with-Hapoel-Ramat-Gan-Givataim|title=Derrick Caracter agreed terms with Hapoel Ramat Gan Givataim|work=Eurobasket.com|date=February 24, 2016|access-date=April 5, 2016}} ===2016–17 season=== On September 6, 2016, Caracter signed with [[BC Prievidza]] of the Slovak [[Slovak Extraliga (basketball)|Extraliga]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/slovakia/211211/derrick-caracter-signs-with-bc-prievidza.html|title=Derrick Caracter signs with BC Prievidza|publisher=Sportando.com|date=6 September 2016|access-date=6 September 2016}} He left Prievidza after appearing in only two games, and on October 5, 2016, he signed with Israeli club [[A.S. Ramat HaSharon]] of the [[Liga Leumit (basketball)|Liga Leumit]].[http://www.eurobasket.com/Israel/news/465040/Ramat-Hasharon-inks-Derrick-Caracter,-ex-Prievidza Ramat Hasharon inks Derrick Caracter, ex Prievidza][http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/213552/derrick-caracter-inks-with-ramat-hasharon.html Derrick Caracter inks with Ramat Hasharon] On December 28, 2016, he left Hasharon and signed in Argentina with Atletico Echague Parana of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]].[http://www.laliganacional.com.ar/laliga/page/noticias/id/10815/title/Echagüe-contrató-a-Derrick-Caracter Echagüe contrató a Derrick Caracter] {{in lang|es}} ===2017–18 season=== On January 11, 2018, Caracter signed with [[Capitanes de Arecibo]].{{cite news|title=Capitanes de Arecibo sign Derrick Caracter|url=https://www.sportando.com/en/america/puerto-rico/260834/capitanes-de-arecibo-sign-derrick-caracter.html|access-date=January 12, 2018|work=Sportando.com|date=January 11, 2018}} ==NBA career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===Regular season=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2010}} | style="text-align:left;"| [[2010–11 Los Angeles Lakers season|L.A.
